component.name: Microsoft 365 for Linux (Unofficial)
component.summary: Microsoft 365 desktop experience with Copilot and OneDrive integration

description.p: Microsoft 365 for Linux (Unofficial) is a community-developed application that provides a Linux desktop experience for Microsoft 365 services.
Access Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Microsoft Copilot and OneDrive using Microsoft official web services.
This application is not developed, affiliated, endorsed or supported by Microsoft Corporation.
